limitations: This record covers rebuilding the judge and development layers from tracked sources using the declared fixed base; it does not establish that the base itself is redistributable. Public 100/100 and hidden 200/200 records were valid with the baseline solver; hidden A == B and reward 0.0. Online used one public session, not the full ten-shard configuration. Full ten-shard acceptance requires a larger clean host. No model score or native Harbor model-driven run is claimed.
